description: Generation-1 research-only full-duplex evaluation benchmark for the existing Frankenstein 2.0 Voice-Slice. Define high-information scenarios spanning overlap/backchannel, barge-in, cancel/commit, long-silence reentry, restart persistence, heard-output binding and duplicate/stale-output rejection. This claim owns benchmark/falsifier research only; it does not mutate product Voice authorities and cannot mint VPS, acoustic, physical, GWT, effect, training or whole-product credit.
